content: {"like":["The compilation showcases the electric chemistry between Steen and Generico across various match types.","The storytelling is described as off the charts and the final match is highlighted as a classic.","The inclusion of the Steen/Corino vs Generico/Cabana matches is praised as golden.","The Steen/Corino vs Kings of Wrestling match is noted as a hidden gem.","The set is recommended as a perfect way to learn the history of the two wrestlers."],"dislike":["The first two tag matches are considered questionable and could have been omitted.","The ROH world title match against Tyler Black is seen as filler.","Several key segments, such as the cage match between Steen/Corino and Generico/Cabana, were omitted."]}
